metadata.title: What Is Seedance? ByteDance AI Video Model Explained
metadata.description: Learn what Seedance is, who created it, how ByteDance Seedance versions differ, where to access them, and how Seedance compares with related AI models.

hero.title: What Is Seedance?
hero.description: Seedance is ByteDance’s family of generative video models for text, image, audio, and video-guided creation. This guide explains the company, versions, access, and practical use.
hero.tip: Availability, pricing, and supported settings can vary by provider, region, and plan.

introduce.title: Seedance in plain language
introduce.description: The Seedance company behind this model family is ByteDance Seed, which generates and edits video from prompts and reference material. The name is often confused with Seedream, which is focused on image generation.

items.title: Created by ByteDance Seed
items.description: The official Seed team publishes the model announcements, capability pages, and release materials.

items.title: A video model family
items.description: Seedance versions support different combinations of text-to-video, image-to-video, reference, editing, audio, and duration controls.

items.title: Hosted access
items.description: People generally use a consumer product or a provider API. Availability and limits are not identical across surfaces.

items.title: Not one fixed app
items.description: “Seedance official website” searches can point to model information, a consumer platform, or an API console. Verify the operator before sharing credentials.

benefits.title: The Seedance concepts people search for
benefits.description: These definitions align common questions such as who owns Seedance, what Seedance 2.0 is, and what changed in 2.5.

items.title: Seedance 1.0 and 1.5 Pro
items.description: Earlier versions established the model family and remain relevant for release history and comparison searches.

items.title: Seedance 2.0
items.description: The current browser generator on this site uses Seedance 2.0 workflows, including supported text, image, and video inputs.

items.title: Seedance 2.5
items.description: The newer model emphasizes 30-second storytelling, richer references, and editing capabilities through supported platforms and APIs.

items.title: Seedance vs Seedream
items.description: Seedance is for video creation; Seedream is a related but distinct image-generation model family. Do not treat the names as interchangeable.

features.title: What to check when researching Seedance
features.description: A reliable answer separates the model owner, product surface, version, provider terms, and current capabilities.

items.title: Official source
items.description: Start with the ByteDance Seed model or announcement page for release-level facts.

items.title: Exact version
items.description: Record whether a page refers to Seedance 1.5 Pro, 2.0, 2.0 Fast, Mini, or 2.5.

items.title: Access surface
items.description: Check the consumer app, ModelArk API, or third-party platform where the feature is actually offered.

items.title: Input and output
items.description: Confirm text, image, video, audio, duration, resolution, editing, and reference limits.

items.title: Rights and moderation
items.description: Read the provider rules for real people, copyrighted characters, music, logos, and commercial work.

items.title: Current date
items.description: Launch pages and screenshots age quickly. Record when the capability was verified.

faq.title: What Is Seedance FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: What is Seedance?
items.answer: Seedance is ByteDance Seed’s generative video model family. It can create or transform video from prompts and reference materials, with capabilities varying by version and provider.

items.question: Who created Seedance?
items.answer: Seedance was created by ByteDance’s Seed team. Official Seed pages publish the model announcements and capability descriptions.

items.question: Who owns Seedance?
items.answer: Seedance belongs to ByteDance. A website or provider that offers access may be an independent platform rather than the model owner.

items.question: What is Seedance 2.0?
items.answer: Seedance 2.0 is a multimodal video model used for text-to-video, image-to-video, video references, editing, and audio-visual workflows on supported surfaces.

items.question: What is Seedance 2.5?
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 is a newer ByteDance Seed video model focused on longer storytelling, broader multimodal references, and more precise editing.

items.question: Are “seadance,” “seeddance,” and “sedance” different products?
items.answer: They are common spelling variants in search queries. The official name is Seedance; use the correctly spelled name when checking sources or signing up.
